8 фактов про коллаген, которые должен знать каждый

1️⃣ После 30 коллаген необходим всем
⠀
Даже после 25 в условиях нашей реальной жизни и питания, мы теряем способность к синтезу эндогенного (внутреннего) коллагена.
⠀
2️⃣ Не работает без порядка в организме
⠀
Дефициты важнейших элементов, ко-факторов, дисбаланс работы органов ЖКТ, неправильная кислотность желудка, нарушенная ферментация приводят к снижению синтеза собственного коллагена и не дают усваиваться добавкам
⠀
3️⃣ Коллаген из добавок не встраивается в ткани в неизменном виде
⠀
Прием коллагена извне необходим для улучшения синтеза экзогенного(собственного) коллагена.
⠀
4️⃣ Для синтеза коллагена нужны помощники
⠀
Важно следить за оптимальным содержанием железа, вит с, вит д (помним оптимальный уровень вит д3?), цинка, магния
Уровень белка в крови не менее 70-75 г/л, а не 60 как в референсах
⠀
5️⃣ Сахар разрушает коллаген
⠀
Помним про скрытый сахар и сахаросодержащие продукты
⠀
6️⃣ Коллаген можно найти на кухне
⠀
Костный бульон (не путать с мясным) отличный источник коллагена. Если конечно есть силы его варить. Знаете тонкости приготовления или надо рассказать? 
⠀
7️⃣ Коллаген лучше принимать в первой половине дня совместно с витамином С
⠀
8️⃣ РАСТИТЕЛЬНОГО  КОЛЛАГЕНА НЕ СУЩЕСТВУЕТ.
Это всего лишь маркетинговый ход. Коллаген бывает морской ( из рыбы, и ее частей, если вы не едите мясо), либо животный (из частей крупного рогатого скота), либо гидролизированный
⠀

My morning as a 66-year-old functional medicine doctor starts before I even touch my phone.

Every morning I come out to my rooftop and let the sunlight hit my eyes. Morning light is one of the most powerful signals you can give your body. It resets your circadian rhythm, regulates melatonin, and reminds your biology what time it is. 

We’re designed to live in sync with nature. Light is how we do that.

Then I sit down and do breathwork.

Five minutes. Three-minute cycle, breath hold, two-minute cycle, breath hold. Simple. But what happens inside your body is anything but. Your nervous system settles, oxygen floods your blood, and this deep stillness kicks in that’s hard to explain until you feel it.

Then some Chi Gong and meditation to close it out.
No screens. No email. Just light, breath, movement, and stillness before the world asks anything of me.

That’s the foundation. Try it for one week and tell me what happens. 👇

Are you fasting the wrong way?

Women have a stronger cortisol response in the morning than men, and it’s directly tied to hunger hormones. When you skip breakfast or push your first meal to noon, those hormones dysregulate for the rest of the day — driving carb cravings, afternoon crashes, and uncontrolled eating at night. The very opposite of what you’re trying to do.

Research shows that women who broke their fast by 8AM and finished eating by 5PM had significantly better metabolic control than those eating in a compressed late window.

You don’t need a 16 hour fast to get the benefits of autophagy, and you definitely don’t need to wait until noon to eat. Simply stop eating after dinner. That’s it.

If you eat dinner at 6 and breakfast at 8, you’ve already done a 14 hour fast without skipping a single meal.

Front load your food, eat earlier, and stop at night. You’ll sleep better, feel better, and lose weight without starving yourself.

Every morning, before the noise of the day sets in, I practice Qigong.

Qigong is a 4,000-year-old Chinese practice that combines slow, intentional movement, breathwork, and meditation to move energy through the body. The word itself says it all: “qi” means life force energy, and “gong” means skill cultivated through practice.

I first came across it when I spent a year living in China after medical school. Every morning, people were moving through tai chi and qigong in the parks at sunrise — just as part of the day. 

That year changed how I think about health. I saw a culture where movement, breath, and food weren’t separate from medicine. They were the medicine.

I brought qigong home with me and never stopped.

I do it every morning because it calms the nervous system while simultaneously energizing the body. It lowers cortisol, reduces inflammation, improves circulation, and gets my mind clear before the day even starts.

Today, at 66, I’m in the best shape of my life.

After decades of studying longevity, metabolism, and chronic disease, my answer keeps coming back to the same thing: muscle. 

Muscle is one of the most important organs of longevity. It regulates blood sugar, supports metabolic health, improves insulin sensitivity, reduces inflammation, protects against injury, and helps preserve independence as you age.

A little over a year ago, I was recovering from back surgery and relying on a walker just to get around. Today, I feel stronger, more capable, and more energized than I have in years.

All because I committed to rebuilding my body, one day at a time. Your body has an incredible capacity to heal, adapt, and grow stronger at any age when you give it the right inputs.

If I can come back from back surgery and build the strongest version of myself at 66, imagine what’s possible for you.

It’s never too late to start. And you’re far more capable than you think.

I couldn’t do 10 push-ups or a single pull-up in my 50s.

I started working out at 59. I’m 66 now and feel stronger than ever before.

Strength training has been one of the most transformative things I’ve done for my health. 

It builds lean muscle mass, which directly supports your metabolic health, insulin sensitivity, and longevity. It protects your bones. 

It reduces your risk of injury and cognitive decline. It signals your body to stay young at a cellular level.

Muscle is medicine. And you don’t need to be an athlete to benefit from it. You just need to start.

Whatever age you are, whatever shape you’re in right now — your body responds. I’m proof of that.

It is never too late. Start now. 💪

Should you exercise fasted or fed? It depends on whether you’re a man or a woman.

Men can get away with training on empty. Women can’t. 

When women exercise without eating first, their bodies produce more stress hormones, blunt the post-workout recovery signals, and miss the window where the real benefits happen. The minimum energy threshold for women to function without dysfunction is more than double that of men.

You don’t need a full meal. You just need something. drstacysims makes a cold protein latte the night before (espresso, almond milk, a scoop of protein) and drinks it on the way to the gym.

And whatever you do, don’t replace real food with protein Cheerios or a Dunkin protein shake. The food industry has mastered the art of slapping the word protein on things that have no business being called food. Read the ingredient list. 

If you can’t pronounce it or find it in your kitchen, put it back.
